bugs_found: compound_interest mutates/rebinds principal with principal *= 0, which is unnecessary and can cause unexpected side effects or TypeError for valid-looking inputs
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/string amounts can raise TypeError or behave inconsistently with the other finance functions
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), accepting invalid fractional inputs without error
fx_convert does not validate that exchange rates are positive, allowing zero or negative conversion results
